## Exercise - Argument order

```{r}
rep(5, 7)
```
## Exercise - Assigning values to variables
It would be 5.
## Exercise - Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
some_text <- "This is some wonderful text."
some_numbers <- 12345
some_boolean <- FALSE


some_text
some_numbers
some_boolean

class(some_text)
class(some_numbers)
class(some_boolean)
```
## Exercise - Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
is_treated_1 <- TRUE
is_treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```
~~Would probably be better to use a frame.~~

## Exercise - Vectors
```{r}
cell_ID <- c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2)
is_treated <- c(is_treated_1, is_treated_2)
num_cells_before <- c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
num_cells_after <- c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
```
## Exercise - Indexing
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
fourth_pet <- all_my_pets[4]
fourth_pet
```
## Exercise - Vectorisation
```{r}
x <- c(2, -4, 6, -2)
x * 2
x > 5
sum(x)
abs(x)
```
## Exercise - Creating a data frame
```{r}
cell_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID,
  is_treated,
  num_cells_before,
  num_cells_after
)

gt(cell_data_frame)
```
